items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: AC1-AC7 met: snapshot/run-written sets cover both places, hand-written recognisers use known_rels, CONFIG_MARKERS all_known_rels, change_type_paths judges a moved root file as the root file, fold/phase-context/handoff report the resolved place, 47 labels use name(); skip-safety stays root-only by design; 10 of 11 recogniser tests fail on the pre-change tree (AC5 pins unchanged behaviour).

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: fold_events resolves sync_config lazily and reports LayoutError as JSON error status; get_phase_context._where falls back to the file name on two copies; the remaining LayoutError surface is R1e.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: SENSITIVE_PATH_RE only gains anchored alternatives; skip-review set unchanged; no basename matching; a planted new-place file gains no FR coverage, no skipped review, and is rejected by the derived-snapshot gate.

items.name: Code Quality
items.note: Mechanical rewrites; CONFIG_FILES derived from CONFIG_KEYS in both modules; no file over 300 lines; ruff clean.

items.name: Test Coverage
items.note: New test_shipwright_paths_recognisers.py drives each real recogniser plus an AST net with a positive control; shape tests and the basenames moved-layout test updated to the new label invariant; full F0 suite.
